children: Sonoco reported third-quarter 2026 net sales of $2.04 billion and a GAAP net loss of $732.1 million, driven principally by a non-cash goodwill impairment charge. Adjusted net income attributable to Sonoco was $167.2 million, or $1.67 per adjusted diluted share, while adjusted EBITDA for the quarter was $351.7 million. The company generated $285 million of operating cash flow in the quarter and maintained $1.3 billion of liquidity as of September 27, 2026.
Financial Highlights
Revenue:
Net sales for the third quarter were $2,041.6 million, down 4.2% year-over-year (excluding discontinued operations).
Gross profit:
Reported gross profit for the quarter was $405.3 million (GAAP).
Operating (loss)/profit:
GAAP operating loss of $(637.96) million in Q3 2026, which includes $829 million of non-cash goodwill impairment charges.
Net (loss)/income:
GAAP net loss attributable to Sonoco of $(732.1) million for the quarter; adjusted net income attributable to Sonoco was $167.2 million.
Adjusted EPS and EBITDA:
Adjusted diluted EPS of $1.67 and adjusted EBITDA of $351.7 million for the three months ended September 27, 2026.
Business Highlights
Goodwill impairment: Non-cash goodwill impairment charges totaling $828.9 million recognized in Q3 2026, primarily related to Consumer Packaging EMEA/APAC and Industrial APAC reporting units.

Segment performance—Consumer Packaging: Net sales declined 2.9% to $1,396.0 million; segment operating profit fell to $179 million with margin at 12.8%, driven by adverse weather impacts on metal can volumes and inflation-driven price/cost dynamics.

Segment performance—Industrial Paper Packaging: Net sales rose 5.2% to $645.6 million; segment operating profit was $88.0 million with a 13.6% margin, supported by pricing actions and strong North America URB trade ton sales (URB ton sales increased 10% year-over-year; mill utilization ~94%).

Cash flow and liquidity: Operating cash flow of $285 million in Q3 and $217.5 million year-to-date (includes ~$103 million of one-time tax payments); cash and cash equivalents of $183.1 million and total liquidity of $1.3 billion as of September 27, 2026.

Balance sheet and capital actions: Total debt $4.29 billion and net debt $4.11 billion at quarter end; company refinanced a $500 million term loan and added $800 million in term loan facilities to extend maturities and enhance flexibility.
